description: Points de captage d'eau potable (directive sur l'eau potable) is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vlaamse Milieu Maatschappij. The data provides an overview of the drinking water abstraction points in Flanders. The data was collected for the EU drinking water directive 98/83/EC. Coverage: Vlaamse Milieu Maatschappij. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water abstraction points (drinking water directive)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Vlaamse Milieu Maatschappij. Its keywords include water, 31991L0676, Drinkwaterrichtlijn, DWD, 31998L0083. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
